Storyboard Maker

Plan your film with a 6-frame storyboard: upload shots or sketch notes, set the shot type and add director's notes.

Your images never leave your browser — the board is rendered locally.

📖 How to use

  1. For each of the 6 frames, optionally upload a shot image.
  2. Pick the shot type and type your director's notes.
  3. The storyboard preview updates live.
  4. Click "Download storyboard" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does the storyboard look like?

The board is a 1600 px wide PNG with 2 columns × 3 rows — each frame has a 16:9 image, shot type and your notes.

Can I use it without uploading images?

Yes — frames without an image get a numbered placeholder, so you can storyboard with notes alone.

Which shot types are available?

Wide, Medium, Close-up, Extreme close-up, Aerial and POV — the standard shot vocabulary.
